plan.title: 3 Days in Lisbon: What to See and Eat
plan.description: A fast plan for three days in Lisbon, covering the hills, the tram rides and the food worth tasting. Quick tips on what to see and eat.

beats.narration: Three days in Lisbon, and every hill hides a view. Day one: ride the yellow trams through the old, winding streets.

props.text: Three days. Seven hills. One city.

beats.narration: Day two, follow the river to the old towers and monasteries. Day three, wander the neighborhoods and listen for live fado music.
Eat custard tarts warm from the oven, grilled sardines, and salted cod. Then climb one more hill for sunset.
